title: Scaffold a form component from a bp.models file
description: Statically reads a developer-authored bp.models/<name>.ts file (a plain export of a FieldModelEntry[] — never generated by us) via ts-morph AST parsing, and writes out a <name>.html/<name>.ts/<name>.scss reusable form component built from field-renderers.ts's static render functions. No routes, no nav entry — this produces a component, not a page.

name.description: The form's name — drives <name>.html/<name>.ts/<name>.scss and the component class/selector (selector: app-<name>).

model.description: Path to the bp.models/<model-name>.ts file, relative to the generated project's root (e.g. bp.models/user.ts).

directory.description: Destination directory for the generated component, relative to src/app/ (e.g. features/orders — NOT a filename; the component's own <name>/ subfolder is appended automatically, so features/orders + --name=order-form produces src/app/features/orders/order-form/order-form.ts). A leading slash or redundant src/app/ prefix is stripped. Default: features/forms.
